[훅 경계] src/app/albums/_hooks/useListenHistoryGearForm.ts (useListenHistoryGearForm(isAuthenticated))
- 상태: selectedMedia, selectedComboId, selectedSourceId/DacAmpId/DacAmp2Id/HeadphoneId, source/dacAmp/headphoneOptions
